changes: Add optional `x-anyagent-source-name` to AnyAgentFunctionToolParam so MCP tools keep the raw server tool name through prompt-bundle validation.
changelog.summary: Accept MCP source-name extension on function tool params.

changes: Add `truncated` flag to observability summary/metrics so the per-run 10k event cap is visible.
changelog.summary: Add per-session tool call averages and truncation flags to observability metrics/summary.

changes: Add optional `tool_source` field to tool planned/result/execution-detail stage events.
Add optional `tool_source` field to NormalizedTelemetryEvent and the Postgres telemetry_events row.
Add `tool_call_counts_by_source` to observability summary/metrics and `tool_source` to tool stats.
Tool invocations now carry a non-null source (command/mcp/builtin) for call-chain grouping.
changelog.summary: Add structured tool source labels to stage events and observability telemetry.

changes: Expose protocol_version as the stable protocol compatibility identifier.
Keep schema_version as the deterministic schema bundle revision.
Publish this changelog block in the schema bundle for SDK and runtime generators.
Add rendered prompt-context replay event and internal prompt-context history endpoint.
Add tool execution detail event and model request event for M2/M3 replay.
Add internal tool-executions and model-request history endpoints.
changelog.summary: Initial versioned protocol schema bundle with endpoint manifest, semantic rules and OpenAPI export.

ToolContext.description:
v0 标准化 context（平台无关 + 平台扩展）：
- v0 允许 extra（例如 future fields），但对已知字段提供结构化校验。
- token/secret 禁止直接放入 context，必须走 auth_ref 引用（服务端再次收口）。

anyagent.protocol.credential_vault.Crede.description: When level is agent, agent_id is required; when level is not agent, agent_id must be null.

anyagent.protocol.mcp.MCPServerConfig.description: A server config must define exactly one source: url for streamable_http/sse or command for stdio. URL sources cannot use stdio; command sources cannot use streamable_http or sse.

anyagent.protocol.multi_agent.SendInputA.description: send_input requires a non-empty message or at least one item.

anyagent.protocol.multi_agent.SpawnAgent.description: spawn_agent requires agent_id. agent_type is a deprecated alias and must match agent_id when both are present.

anyagent.protocol.tool_runtime.ToolConte.description: ToolContext must reference credentials via auth_ref or credential_id. Plaintext secret-like keys such as token, api_key, password, authorization, bearer_token, and common suffix variants are rejected recursively.
